programme.title: Dan & Gran
programme.desc: Stan spots a swift and spies a mystery - why don't they ever land? Grace acts as air-traffic control and Stan and Gran take to the skies. Tha Dan a' faicinn gòbhlan-mòr agus rùn-dìomhair – carson nach tig 'ad gu talamh? Tha Ceit mar neach-obrach bhon tùr-stiùiridh, agus tha Dan is Gran a' dèanamh air na sgòthan.

programme.title: Losgannan | Froglets
programme.desc: Tha Sif, Pipp agus Bran a’ gabhail pàirt ann an latha chleasan nan Losgann. Ziff, Pipp and Button compete in their own Froggie sports day.

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Tha am Màidsear air fear de na h-innleachdan feumail aige a chruthachadh, ach chan eil còir aig duine beantainn ris fhad 's a tha e air falbh. Bu mhòr am beud nach do dh'èist Beag ris. Major has come up with one of his useful inventions, but no-one is allowed to touch it while he is away. It’s a shame that Beag didn’t listen to him.

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Tha na Clangairean airson latha sònraichte a thoirt do Dhràgon Brot air sgàth ‘s gu bheil i cho fialaidh ‘s còir. Tha min dòchas gun obraich seo a-mach math dhaibh. The Clangers would like to organise a special day for Soup Dragon as she is so kind and generous. Hopefully this works out well for them.

programme.title: Peicein/Petit
programme.desc: Tha Peicein is Lòra ag argamaid mu dheidhinn cò aca a bu chòir na riaghailtean a dhèanamh suas airson geama Ghriogair is Raghnaill. Fhad ’s a tha iadsan a’ feuchainn ri obrachadh a-mach cò aca a bu chòir a bhith nan sgiobair, tha Griogair agus Raghnall a’ cumail a’ cluich às aonais a’ bhuill. Petit and Laura argue about who should be the one that makes the rules of Greg and Roman's game. While they decide who should be the captain, Greg and Roman wait for them to make a decision and continue playing without the ball.

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Iain MacAonghais a’ leughadh Caiptean Wag agus na Mathain Bhàna. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh agus a dhealbhachadh le Michael Terry agus chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Mòrag Stiùbhart. A bedtime story for young children. Iain MacInnes reads Caiptean Wag agus na Mathain Bhàna, written and illustrated by Michael Terry and translated into Gaelic by Morag Stewart.

programme.title: Belle and Sebastian
programme.desc: Tha rèis dhan bhàrr dol bhith ann – a’ chiad oileanach a chuireas flaga air Beinn Rocaid a' buinnig na duais. Ach bheil cuideigin na chealgaire? A race to the summit is going to take place - the first student to plant a flag on Mount Rocket will win the trophy. But is somebody a cheat?

programme.title: Belle and Sebastian
programme.desc: Tha mòran ri innse an-diugh – mar a theich Sebastian ri Linn burraidheachd Chamshron, is tha sinn cuideachd ’g ionnsachadh mun chiad choinneachadh le Belle. There’s much to tell today - how Sebastian decided to run away as a result of Cameron’s bullying, and we learn about his first meeting with Belle.

programme.title: Seonaidh | Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Tha Bitzer air crìoch a chuir air an obair-taighe gu lèir agus a-nis chan eil càil aige ri dhèanamh. The e air a dhòigh nuair a mhothachas e gu bheil an t-sabhal feumach air sgioblachadh - gus an tig e tairsinn air dealbh nach gabh a chrochadh gu dìreach! Bitzer has completed all his chores and is at a bit of a loss. He's delighted when he discovers the flock's barn needs a good tidy-up, until he comes across a wonky picture that just won't hang straight.

programme.title: Alba Eagalach
programme.desc: Tha sgioba CBBC ALBA a’ toirt thugainn cuid de na sgeulachdan agus na tachartasan as eagalaiche ann an eachdraidh na h-Alba. Anns a’ phrògram seo, coinnichidh sinn ri Uilleam Uallas agus cluinnidh sinn mun bheatha eagalach a bh’ aige ach chan eil e fhèin ro dheònach bruidhinn mu dheidhinn! CBBC ALBA brings us some of the scariest stories from Scottish history. In this episode, we meet William Wallace and uncover the grisly details of his life. Surprisingly, he doesn't seem too keen to talk about these!

programme.title: Flix
programme.desc: Tha eadar-dhealaichidhean air an comharrachadh san sgoil is, mar dhùbhlain, tha aig Flix is Burma ri bhith càirdeil ri chèile. Chan eil fhios ciamar a dh'obraicheas seo a-mach ge-tà! Differences are celebrated in school and, as a challenge, Flix and Burma have to be friendly with one another. Nobody knows how this will work out though!

programme.title: Fillte
programme.desc: Fillte goes on a journey throughout Scotland to discover the history and contemporary hand-crafted practice behind the artisan production of woven fabrics, such as wool, hemp, linen, grasses, leather and many more unorthodox materials. Tha Fillte a gabhail turas tro Alba a’ sireadh eachdraidh agus sgeulachdan an latha ’n diugh co-cheangailte ris an luchd-ciùird a tha snìomh ‘s ag obrachadh diofar stuthan, leithid, clòimh, corcach, anart, feur,leathar, agus iomadh seorsa stuth iongantach eile.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Sara Robertson is Joy’s guest in the studio and chats about her unusual home, while Calum Maclean is on Great Bernera, trying to a find an unusual historic property.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Rathad Ramsay
programme.desc: Ramsay MacMahon meets well-known Gaels across Scotland to share stories, appreciate nature and reflect on their lives. Ramsay walks with Coinneach Rankin in Lochalsh, the area where he grew up and still calls home. San treas sreath de Rathad Ramsay bidh Ramsay MacMahon a’ coinneachadh ri sàr Ghàidheil bho air feadh Alba ‘s iad a’ co-roinn sgeulachdan, cuir luach air nàdar agus a’ cnuasachadh ma beatha. Tha Ramsay a’ coinneachadh ri Coinneach MacFhraing ann an Loch Aillse, an t-àite far an do thogar e agus ris an abair e fhathast a dhachaigh. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Am Balla (The Wall)
programme.desc: Tha Ramsay MacMahon ag ionnsachadh mu bheatha air a’ chrìoch eadar an Fhionnlainn agus an Ruis. Bho thug an Ruis ionnsaigh air an Ucràin ann an 2022 tha a’ chrìoch air dùnadh gu tur, ag atharrachadh beatha dhaoine air gach taobh. Anns an Fhionnlainn, cluinnidh Ramsay sgeulachdan bho theaghlaichean a chaidh a’ sgaradh bho an luchd-gràdh air taobh eile na crìche. Coinnichidh e riuthsan air a bheil an dleastanas ‘son tèarainteachd aig a’ chrìoch agus cluinnidh e bho dhaoine a chaill am beòshlaint’ gu h-obann air sgàth an dùnaidh. Ramsay MacMahon learns about life along the border between Finland and Russia. Since Russia’s attack on Ukraine in 2022 the border has closed completely, transforming the lives of people on both sides. In Finland, Ramsay hears the stories of families who have been separated from their loved ones on the other side, meets those responsible for securing the border and hears from people who have lost their livelihood overnight because of its closure. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Faodail
programme.desc: Tha Tasglann Fhilm Faodail a’ tarraing aire gu filmichean dhùthchasach Innse Gall bho na 1930an gu na 80an, a bha caillte ach a-nis glèidhte don ghinealach ri teachd. Tha bhana Cinema Sgìre Leantainneach a’ siubhal nan eilean, a’ taisbeanadh fhilmichean sna sgìrean ionadail, le cothrom am faicinn air-loidhne air feadh an t-saoghail. Cuirear aithris bheairteach ùr riutha, a’ buntainn ris a’ Ghàidhealtachd, airson luchd-amhairc an là an-diugh. The Faodail Film Archive celebrates lost indigenous film collections from the 1930s-1980s in the Outer Hebrides, preserving the archive for future generations. The Cinema Sgìre Continuing mobile cinema van travels the islands, showcasing footage to local communities, making them accessible globally online and adding rich new narratives relevant to the Gàidhealtachd for contemporary audiences. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Dàna | Scotland's Wild Side
programme.desc: A’ sireadh Dànachd anns an Roinn Eòrpa, tha Coinneach MacFhraing a’ siubhal gu dùthaich nam beann iongantach – Nirribhidh. Còmhla ri a chompanach sreap, Calum Gibb, bidh Coinneach a’ dìreadh ‘Stetind’, stùc le eachdraidh bheairteach a tha air mac-meanmna luchd-sreap a ghlacadh airson còrr is ceud bliadhna. Seeking adventure on a grand scale in Europe, Coinneach Rankin travels to the mountain paradise of Norway. Along with his climbing partner, Calum Gibb, Coinneach makes an ascent of Stetind, a peak with a storied past that has captured the imagination of mountaineers for well over a century. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Ro Thrath don t-Saoghal/Born too Soon
programme.desc: Obair sgioba an Aonad Dlùth-chùram Leanabain ’s iad a’ coimhead an dèidh naoidheanan so-leònta. The work of the NICU team and their care for vulnerable babies.

programme.title: Fraochy Bay
programme.desc: Tha sgioba bata teasairginn Fraochy Bay a' dol a-sas ann an trèanadh agus a sùil ri de na dh'fhaodadh tighinn le blàthachadh na cruinne. Tha am bàrd Torcuil Fearchar deònach cobhair a dhèanamh oirre ach co a nith cobhair aire-san? The Fraochy Bay lifeboat crew are having a training day. The scenario involves an icy adventure. Passing poet Torquil Farquhar is roped in to help and is well-versed in his role, but what about the lifeboat crew?

programme.title: Binneas - Na Trads
programme.desc: Roghainn bho oidhche mhòr duaisean Na Trads 2022. A nochd ceòl bho St Roch’s & Tayside Young Fiddlers. Highlights from the Trad Awards 2022 with music from St Roch’s and Tayside Young Fiddlers.

programme.title: An Clo Mor
programme.desc: After years of unhappiness, mill worker Mairead finally walks out of her decades-long marriage and into the arms of the person she loves - hotel owner Cairistiona. However, as the women agree to wait for the right time to tell Mairead’s husband Boyd they are together, little do they know there’s someone watching from the shadows. Às dèidh bliadhnaichean de mhì-thoileachas, tha neach-obrach na muilne, Mairead, a’ fàgail an duine aice às dèidh bliadhnaichean fada pòsta airson a bhith còmhla ris an neach air a bheil gaol aice – Cairistìona, aig a bheil an taigh-òsta. Ach, ged a tha na boireannaich agaontachadh feitheamh gus innse dha Boyd, an duine aig Mairead, gu bheil iad còmhla – ‘s beag a dh’fhios a th’ aca gu bheil cuideigin ‘san dorchadas gan coimhead. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Tha tòrr a’ gabhail àite an-diugh nuair a tha Bing agus a’ charaidean a-dol dhan choille airson dealbhan-duilleig a tharraing ach chan eil e furasta nuair a tha a’ ghaoth ag èirigh. There’s a lot happening when Bing and friends make leaf pictures in the forest, but the wind doesn’t make things easy for them.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Nuair a tha einnsean-smàlaidh sa phàirc, tha Sula agus Pando a' faihinn cothrom air suidhe na bhroinn ach tha Bing tàmailteach nuair a tha aig an einnsean-smàlaidh ri falbh ann an cabhaig. When a fire engine is displayed in the park, Sula and Pando get the opportunity to sit inside it, but Bing is disappointed when it needs to leave in a hurry.

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: Thig air turas eile sgoinneil le na h-Abadas. 'S e 'put' am facal ùr a tha aca. Cò a thèid air a thòrr an-diugh: Hari, Ela, neo Seren? Join the Abadas for another 'abadobedee' adventure. This episode's word is 'buoy'. Who will be chosen to find today's exciting new word; Hari, Ela or Seren?

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal
programme.desc: ‘S e latha ciùin a th’ ann, ach tha Nìp a’ cladhach thuill air feadh an eilein, is cha stad e. Tha Àtaidh is Tilidh a’ feuchainn ri obrachadh a-mach gu dè tha ga fhàgail air bhioran mar seo. Feumaidh gur e a cho-là-breith a th’ ann! It is a peaceful day but Neep is digging holes all over the Island and won’t stop. Abney and Teal try to work out why he is so excited. It must be his birthday!

programme.title: ’S E Iasg a Th’Annam (I’m a Fish)
programme.desc: Tha an t-Iasg Garibaldi ag innse dhuinn mar a tha ìomhaigh aige ri chumail suas, mar a bhios e a' lorg a charaid, agus mar a bhios e a’ coimhead às deidh nead làn uighean The Garibaldi Fish tells us how he has an image to uphold, the way he finds his mate and how he looks after a nest full of eggs.

programme.title: Orain CBeebies
programme.desc: Taghadh farsaing de dh’òrain bho Carrie, Linda, Ruairidh agus sgioba CBeebies ALBA. A selection of songs from Carrie, Linda, Ruairidh and the CBeebies ALBA presenters.

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Mòrag Anna NicNèill a’ leughadh Chan Fhaic Cearcan san Dorchadas. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh agus a dhealbhachadh le Kristyna Litten agus chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Jo NicDhòmhnaill. A bedtime story for young children. Morag Ann MacNeil reads Chan Fhaic Cearcan san Dorchadas, written and illustrated by Kristyna Litten and translated into Gaelic by Jo Macdonald.

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan/Bottersnikes and Gumbles
programme.desc: Nuair tha Bonns is Uilidh a' sàbhaladh Throig bhon Bhògais-shìd’, tha e uabhasach neo-thaingeil. Cho neo-thaingeil ‘s gu bheil e a' tilleadh air ais chun na Bògaisean. Ach tha e ag ionnsachadh gu bheil caraidean feumail aig a' cheann thall! When Bonns and Uilidh save Troig from Bògais-shìd’, he is very ungrateful. So much so, that he returns to see the Bògaisean. However, he learns that friends are helpful, at the end of the day!

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan/Bottersnikes and Gumbles
programme.desc: Tha Uilidh airson dearbhadh gu bheil e treun – dìreach mar an Gumbal gun Ainm. Ciamar a thèid dha? Bheil e treun no bheil e dìreach gòrach? Uilidh wants to prove that he is a hero just like the Un-named Gumbal. How will he get on? Is he brave or is he just foolish?

programme.title: Seonaidh | Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Tha Bitzer air crìoch a chuir air an obair-taighe gu lèir agus a-nis chan eil càil aige ri dhèanamh. Bitzer has completed all his chores and is at a bit of a loss. He's delighted when he discovers the flock's barn needs a good tidy-up, until he comes across a wonky picture that just won't hang straight.

programme.title: Hilda
programme.desc: Tha Hilda, Flòraidh is Daibhidh a’ feuchainn ri bràistean Sgùdan Sporais às ùr a chosnadh. Air sgàth sin, tha 'ad dol a’ shireadh planntraisean annasach ionadail – agus abair g’ eil sin na chuairt-dànachd glè inntinneach. Hilda, Flòraidh and Daibhidh are trying to earn new Sgùdan Sporrais badges. They go in search of rare, local plants, and this turns into a very interesting adventure.

programme.title: Seòid a' Chidsin - The Kitchen Coves
programme.desc: Abair gu bheil maorach a’ còrdadh ri na seòid agus anns a’ phrògram-sa, tha iad a’ còcaireachd le crùbag, rud air a bheilear tric a’ dèanamh dearmaid. Tha Ùisdean ag ullachadh ciad cùrsa dathte a’ cleachdadh feòil chrùbaig dhonn agus deiseag. Tha Ruairidh a’ dèanamh Linguine Crùbaig fhad ’s a tha Ùisdean cuideachd a’ dèanamh pasta, Ravioli air a lìonadh le feòil crùbaig agus bisque crùbaig. Aig deireadh gnothaich, tha Ruairidh a’ cruthachadh biadh sònraichte, spring rolls crùbaig teth is fuar. The lads love seafood, and the often overlooked and underrated crab features in this episode. Uisdean prepares a colourful crab starter using brown and velvet crab meat. Ruaridh makes an interesting crab linguini while Uisdean continues the pasta thread by making ravioli filled with crab meat and a crab bisque. To finish, Ruaridh creates a speciality, hot and cold crab spring rolls. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Singer and Gaelic teacher Margaret Macleod Nicholson is Joy’s studio guest, and Calum Maclean visits Scotland’s newest city and once ancient capital, Dunfermline.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Port An Obain
programme.desc: We meet Oban resident Duncan MacNeil, who works as a Gaelic officer, and also Sileas Sinclair, who keeps alive the family passion for traditional music.

programme.title: Ro Thrath don t-Saoghal/Born too Soon
programme.desc: Mu dheireadh thall, tha a triùir leanabain aig Kinga na gàirdeanan, fhad ’s a tha Emily a’ dol tro dheuchainnean a bharrachd. Tha fradharc Diane ann an cunnart, gheibh Treasa agus Ian naidheachd a dh’fhàgas an cridheachan briste, agus tha Tom Òg a’ ruighinn clach-mhìle chudromach. Kinga finally holds her triplets together, while Emily undergoes further tests. Diane faces a risk to her sight, Treasa and Ian receive devastating news, and Tom Óg reaches a key milestone. Dubbed in Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Fraochy Bay
programme.desc: Tha am bard fhathast a' feitheamh cobhair ach chaneil sgeul air a bhata-teasairginn ach tha a sgioba sin air an cul a chuir ri treanadh agus fior suidheachadh eiginneach rompa. Tha croitear agus a chuid chaorach air a dhol a-mach air a cheile. Torquil Farquhar has just been left stranded on a dummy iceberg in Fraochy Bay as the lifeboat abandons its training session and heads off to a real life emergency. A local crofter is being held hostage by his mutinous sheep.

programme.title: Abigail
programme.desc: An greimean lòin as fheàrr le Abigail, 's e Buntàta Cruasbach Sàiste. 'Ad cho blast' 's a tha 'ad rin ithe. Tha 'n seòrs' aice-se soirbh a dhèanamh; feumaidh tu fheuchainn. Abigail’s favourite snack lunch is crispy sage potatoes. It's as nice to look at as to eat and her version is easy to make - you must try it! In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Glan Fhèin
programme.desc: Angela and Katie compete against Shonnie and Calum from rival company Sgiobalta. It’s an upstairs-downstairs, girls v boys clean-off where the winner gets the contract. Things get messy, featuring stains, smudges and romantic complications. The timing isn’t perfect, as it clashes with the anniversary of Katie’s infamous disastrous reality TV appearance. Meanwhile, Betty and Dido are on a publicity push where they ditch leaflets and embrace dancing on social media. And Daniel makes a new furry friend as he gets busy with his air freshener.

programme.title: An t-Uisge/Rain Stories
programme.desc: Anne Lundon hears about acid rain, first identified after the Industrial Revolution.

programme.desc: Tha seillean glacte ann an uamhag Bhernie agus, gun e air biadh fhaighinn, tha e cho fann ‘s nach dèan e a shlighe dhachaigh! Ge-tà, tha Oona ‘s Baba deònach a dhol a-lorg biadh dha gus am fàs e làidir a-rithist! There’s a bee trapped in Bernie’s grotto but without anything to eat, he has become too weak to escape and make his way back to the hive. However, Oona and Baba are on hand to find and bring him the food he needs to build his strength back up!

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha Mossy airson a dhol air turas-ionmhais bidhe ach ‘s ann a dh’ fheumas an sgioba dhol air misean-seilg' eadar-dhealaichte 's Pip ‘s Pop air a dhol am falach air Otto bochd! Mossy wants the gang to join him on a food hunt, but they are all called on a different sort of search when Pip and Pop decide to hide on poor Otto!

programme.desc: Man Ray rents Squidward's house. Tha An Sòrnan a’ gabhail taigh Ghiobaird air mhàl.

programme.desc: Leis mar a chaidh sgrùdadh na sgoile an-uiridh, tha bòrd na sgoile air Leas-Cheannard ùr, Ms Dallas, a thoirt a-steach gus sùil ghèir a chumail air Mgr Mackle. Bidh sinn a' coinneachadh ri tidsearean ùra agus ri feadhainn air a bheil sinn air eòlas a chuir roimhe. After last year’s school inspection, the school board has appointed a new deputy head, Ms Dallas, to keep an eye on Mr Mackle. We meet new teachers alongside some recognisable personalities.

programme.title: Alba Eagalach
programme.desc: Tha sgioba CBBC ALBA a’ toirt thugainn cuid de na sgeulachdan agus na tachartasan as eagalaiche ann an eachdraidh na h-Alba. Anns a’ phrògram seo, coinnichidh sinn ri Uilleam Uallas agus cluinnidh sinn mun bheatha eagalach a bh’ aige ach chan eil e fhèin ro dheònach bruidhinn mu dheidhinn! CBBC ALBA brings us some of the scariest stories from Scottish history. In this episode, we meet William Wallace and uncover the grisly details of his life. Surprisingly, he doesn't seem too keen to talk about these!

programme.title: Geamaichean Gorach
programme.desc: Mar ‘s àbhaist, tha Coinneach Clogaid a’ feuchainn ri casg a chur air a h-uile Farpaiseach eile. Na can rium gu bheil e dol a bhuannachadh an trup-sa, ge-tà? ‘S cinnteach nach eil? As ever, Coinneach Clogaid is trying to stop all the other competitors. Don’t tell me he’s going to win this time though. Surely not?

programme.title: Belle and Sebastian
programme.desc: Tha mòran ri innse an-diugh – mar a theich Sebastian ri Linn burraidheachd Chamshron, is tha sinn cuideachd ’g ionnsachadh mun chiad choinneachadh le Belle. There’s much to tell today - how Sebastian decided to run away as a result of Cameron’s bullying, and we learn about his first meeting with Belle.

programme.title: Seonaidh | Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Tha an tuathanach a' co-dhùnadh raon goilf a thogail air an tuathanas gus aire an sguibhir ionadail a ghlacadh. Nuair a mhothachas an treud gun caill iad an dump aca air a bheil iad cho dèidheil, feumaidh iad a thighinn an àrda le plana innleachdail gus a shàbhaladh. The farmer decides to build a golf course on the farm to impress the local squire. When the flock discover they'll lose their beloved dump, they must come up with an imaginative solution to try and save it.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Abigail
programme.desc: Tha Bagelean Abigail fìor bhlast' agus sònraicht' 'son bruinse no lòn, no fiù 's aig àm sam bith, 's 'ad gad shàsachadh ann an dòigh nach gabh inns' 's iad fèìr taght' 'son an roinn leis an teaghlach no le caraidean. Abigail’s bagels are a very special and tasty brunch or lunch, or anytime experience, satisfying to the extreme and just the thing to share with family and friends. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Fonn mo Bheatha
programme.desc: Ceòl agus còmhradh le Cathy Ann Nic a Phi còmhla ri Iseabail NicAsgailll. Music and chat programme presented by Cathy Ann MacPhee with guest Ishbel MacAskill. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Bus Ghlaschu/Glasgow Bus
programme.desc: Bus Ghlaschu - sreath à Èirinn a’ toirt sùil air na caractaran air a’ bhus eadar Glaschu is Dùn nan Gall is na sgeulachdan timcheall air na tursan aca. A look at the characters and stories around the bus that runs between Donegal and Glasgow.

programme.title: Mas Fhior
programme.desc: Seo an fharpais-cheist far a bheil barrachd air eòlas coitcheann a dhìth gus buannachadh. Le Niall Iain Dòmnhallach aig an stiùir cluichidh na sgiobaidhean anns an stiùideo an aghaidh an ochdnar Mas Fhìoraich a tha a’ cluich bhon dachaighean fhèin agus a tha a’ cur nan ceistean. A’ strì an aghaidh na Mas Fhìoraich airson feuchainn air an duais mhòr, tha DK is Kenna agus Kirsty is Seònaid. Presented by Niall Iain MacDonald, this is the quiz show where more than general knowledge is required to win. Playing from the comfort of their own homes are the Pretenders, and they are the ones posing the questions. Battling the Pretenders to win the big prize are DK and Kenna, and Kirsty and Janet. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Third Lanark
programme.desc: Ann an 1967, agus e faisg air ceud bliadhna a dh'aois, chaidh cluba ball-coise le eachdraidh shòisealta is chultarail sònraichte à bith. As dèidh 95 bliadhna de dh'eachdraidh phròiseil chaidh innse gun robh Cluba Lùth-chleasachd Third Lanark banc-briste, agus chaidh na geataichean gu Pàirce Chathkin an dùnadh airson an turas mu dheireadh. Tha Third Lanark ag innse an sgeulachd mu dheidhinn cluba coimhearsnachd sònraichte, a' coimhead ri mar a chaidh a stèidheachadh, na làithean buidhe a thuilleadh air na làithean a bu dhuirche an uair a chaidh an cluba à bith. In 1967, as it edged towards its centenary, a much-loved social and cultural institution was consigned to history. Following 95 years of emotional highs and lows, Glasgow's Third Lanark Athletic Club was bankrupt, and the gates to Cathkin Park were closed. Third Lanark is the fascinating story of this iconic community club, exploring its formation and existence, as well as its catastrophic collapse.

programme.title: Ciad-fàthan nan Creutairean/Wild Senses
programme.desc: Tha Còmhraidhean Ceimigeach a’ toirt sùil air mar a tha beathaichean a’ dèananmh feum de bhlas agus fàileadh airson conaltradh agus maireachdainn beò ann an dòighean do-chreidsinneach. This episode tunes into how animals use taste and smell to survive and communicate in ways that defy belief. Dubbed in Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Skipinnish Aig A' Chaisteal
programme.desc: Skipinnish le Last of the Hunters ann an cuideachd na mìltean de luchd-leantainn aig cuirm-chiùil a’ comharrachadh 25 bliadhna de Skipinnish, bho Chaisteal Dhùn Èideann. Skipinnish perform Last of the Hunters in front of thousands of fans at a concert celebrating 25 years of the band, from Edinburgh Castle.

programme.title: Seirm
programme.desc: Prògram de cheòl traidiseanta agus freumhach air a lìbhrigeadh le Màiri Anna NicUalraig. A’ taisbeanaidh chlàraidhean is chòmhraidhean a chaidh a dhèanamh aig àm Celtic Connections 2024, chìte cuid den luchd-ciùil a b’ fheàrr a bha aig an fhèis, leithid Talisk, Julie Fowlis/Éamon Doorley/Zoë Conway/John Mc Intyre, Glen Hansard & Breanndán Ó Beaglaoich, Buffalo Nichols agus Pine Tree Flyers. Traditional and roots music show presented by Mary Ann Kennedy. Filmed during Celtic Connections 2024, Seirm showcases bespoke recordings and conversations with some of the best artists appearing at the festival. This episode features performances from Talisk; Julie Fowlis, Éamon Doorley, Zoë Conway, John McIntyre; Glen Hansard & Breanndán Ó Beaglaoich, Buffalo Nichols and Pine Tree Flyers. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: Thig air turas eile sgoinneil le na h-Abadas. 'S e 'put' am facal ùr a tha aca. Cò a thèid air a thòrr an-diugh: Hari, Ela, neo Seren? Join the Abadas for another 'abadobedee' adventure. This episode's word is 'buoy'. Who will be chosen to find today's exciting new word; Hari, Ela or Seren?

programme.title: Peicein/Petit
programme.desc: Tha Peicein a’ fiathachadh a charaidean gu àite-obrach athar. Ach chan eil Dadaidh Pheicein a’ leigeil leotha suathadh ann an dad ach an t-ùrlar, is tha sin a’ fàs dòrainneach. Mu dheireadh thall, tha Dadaidh Pheicein a’ sealltainn dhaibh gun urrainn saorsainneachd a bhith air leth spòrsail. Petit invites his friends to his dad's workplace. But his dad won't let them touch anything except the floor and they start to get really bored. Finally, Petit's dad shows them how carpentry can be lots of fun.

programme.title: Pompon Am Mathan Beag/Pompon Little Bear
programme.desc: Tha Mamaidh air rud dìomhair innse do Phompon - tha i air cuirm a' chur air dòigh 'son cò-là-breith Dadaidh - ach ciamar a chumas Pompon an rùn-dìomhair? Mamaidh has told Pompon a secret - she's arranged a party for Daddy's birthday. But how will Pompon keep the secret?

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal
programme.desc: ‘S e latha ciùin a th’ ann, ach tha Nìp a’ cladhach thuill air feadh an eilein, is cha stad e. Tha Àtaidh is Tilidh a’ feuchainn ri obrachadh a-mach gu dè tha ga fhàgail air bhioran mar seo. Feumaidh gur e a cho-là-breith a th’ ann! It is a peaceful day but Neep is digging holes all over the Island and won’t stop. Abney and Teal try to work out why he is so excited. It must be his birthday!

programme.title: Sionnach agus Maigheach (Fox & Hare)
programme.desc: Gach oidhche bidh Comhachag a’ cumail geàrd air a’ choille. Ge-tà, leis a’ ghealach a’ sìor fhàs tana agus a’ choille a’ sìor fhàs dorcha, tha Comhachag a’ fàs aonranach. Chan eil e idir cho measail air a dhleastanas. Gu fortanach, tha plàna aig Maigheach! Every night, Owl keeps watch over the forest. But with the Moon growing thinner and the woods growing darker night by night, Owl begins to feel lonely. He starts to dread his duties. Luckily, Hare has a plan!

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: SPFL
programme.desc: Ball-coise beò bho Lìog a h-aon le Montrose a’ cur fàilte air Alloa Athletic. An geama slàn ri fhaicinn le aithris bho Ailig O’ Henley. Football coverage from League 1 as Montrose host Alloa Athletic. All the action live, with commentary from Alex O’Henley.

programme.title: Bus Ghlaschu/Glasgow Bus
programme.desc: Bus Ghlaschu - sreath à Èirinn a’ toirt sùil air na caractaran air a’ bhus eadar Glaschu is Dùn nan Gall is na sgeulachdan timcheall air na tursan aca. A look at the characters and stories around the bus that runs between Donegal and Glasgow.

programme.title: Dàna | Scotland's Wild Side
programme.desc: A’ sireadh Dànachd anns an Roinn Eòrpa, tha Coinneach MacFhraing a’ siubhal gu dùthaich nam beann iongantach – Nirribhidh. Còmhla ri a chompanach sreap, Calum Gibb, bidh Coinneach a’ dìreadh ‘Stetind’, stùc le eachdraidh bheairteach a tha air mac-meanmna luchd-sreap a ghlacadh airson còrr is ceud bliadhna. Seeking adventure on a grand scale in Europe, Coinneach Rankin travels to the mountain paradise of Norway. Along with his climbing partner, Calum Gibb, Coinneach makes an ascent of Stetind, a peak with a storied past that has captured the imagination of mountaineers for well over a century. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Rathad Ramsay
programme.desc: Ramsay MacMahon meets well-known Gaels across Scotland to share stories, appreciate nature and reflect on their lives. Ramsay walks with Coinneach Rankin in Lochalsh, the area where he grew up and still calls home. San treas sreath de Rathad Ramsay bidh Ramsay MacMahon a’ coinneachadh ri sàr Ghàidheil bho air feadh Alba ‘s iad a’ co-roinn sgeulachdan, cuir luach air nàdar agus a’ cnuasachadh ma beatha. Tha Ramsay a’ coinneachadh ri Coinneach MacFhraing ann an Loch Aillse, an t-àite far an do thogar e agus ris an abair e fhathast a dhachaigh. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Seirm
programme.desc: Prògram de cheòl traidiseanta agus freumhach air a lìbhrigeadh le Màiri Anna NicUalraig. Filmed during Celtic Connections 2024, Seirm showcases bespoke recordings and conversations with some of the best artists appearing at the festival. This episode features performances from Carlene Carter, Ewen Henderson, Talisk and intimate session recordings with Sarah Jarosz and Muireann Bradley. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Ro Thrath don t-Saoghal/Born too Soon
programme.desc: Mu dheireadh thall, tha a triùir leanabain aig Kinga na gàirdeanan, fhad ’s a tha Emily a’ dol tro dheuchainnean a bharrachd. Tha fradharc Diane ann an cunnart, gheibh Treasa agus Ian naidheachd a dh’fhàgas an cridheachan briste, agus tha Tom Òg a’ ruighinn clach-mhìle chudromach. Kinga finally holds her triplets together, while Emily undergoes further tests. Diane faces a risk to her sight, Treasa and Ian receive devastating news, and Tom Óg reaches a key milestone. Dubbed in Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Fraochy Bay
programme.desc: Tha am breitheamh a' feitheamh agus tha a' diuraidh deiseil agus deonach. Chaneil a dhith a' nise ach eucoireach neo dha. Fraochy Bay's Sheriff Court is now in session and a few cases are due to be heard. Just what kind of mayhem and miscreants have been stalking the streets of Fraochy Bay?

programme.desc: Ann an 1967, agus e faisg air ceud bliadhna a dh'aois, chaidh cluba ball-coise le eachdraidh shòisealta is chultarail sònraichte à bith. As dèidh 95 bliadhna de dh'eachdraidh phròiseil chaidh innse gun robh Cluba Lùth-chleasachd Third Lanark banc-briste, agus chaidh na geataichean gu Pàirce Chathkin an dùnadh airson an turas mu dheireadh. Following 95 years of emotional highs and lows, Glasgow's Third Lanark Athletic Club was bankrupt, and the gates to Cathkin Park were closed. Third Lanark is the fascinating story of this iconic community club, exploring its formation and existence, as well as its catastrophic collapse.

programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Magnificent Monuments
programme.desc: Fred Dibnah continues his tour of Britain's great building feats with a look at our places of work. In Chatham he visits one of our oldest dockyards, while at Armley Mills in Leeds he discovers an early form of fireproofing. His journey takes him from a 1,000-year-old tithe barn in Sussex, where he tries his hand at thatching, to the symbol of modern architecture, the Lloyd's building.

programme.title: War Walks
programme.desc: 1 July 1916 was the blackest day in the British army's history. Richard Holmes walks the fields where 57,000 soldiers were killed or wounded in just a few hours, and continues the story until the end of the Somme campaign in 1916.

programme.title: The Stuarts
programme.desc: This three-part series argues that the Stuarts, more than any other, were Britain's defining royal family. After Charles I's disastrous attempt to militarily impose political and religious uniformity throughout his kingdoms, both the Stuart dynasty and its three kingdoms fell into an abyss. Charles lost his head and his family fled into exile. In this second episode, Dr Clare Jackson reveals how the unprecedented religious violence of the Wars of the Three Kingdoms shaped the very DNA of British political culture and how the trauma suffered influenced constitutional crises in the years to come.

programme.title: Colour: The Spectrum of Science
programme.desc: Helen Czerski uncovers what colour is, how it works and how it has written the story of our planet. She seeks out the hues that turned the Earth multicoloured.

programme.title: Chauvet: Humanity's First Great Masterpiece
programme.desc: In December 1994, an archaeological marvel hidden deep inside France’s Gorges de l’Ardèche was revealed to the modern world for the very first time: the Chauvet cave. Scientists immediately recognised the importance of this discovery. Sealed by a landslide more than 20,000 years ago, the cave had been extraordinarily well preserved. With over 1,000 paintings adorning its walls, Chauvet is a cave art jewel. How were the hidden chambers first formed? Who created the extraordinary art? And how can we preserve it for future generations? This film follows a 30-year archaeological, geological and artistic adventure as scientists endeavour to understand and conserve this exceptional record of humanity’s distant past.

programme.title: Ice Cold in Alex
programme.desc: During the German offensive in Libya in 1942, Captain Anson, commander of a motor ambulance convoy, finds himself cut off from his unit with only an old ambulance to take him back to Alexandria. His companions are two young nurses and his sergeant, Tom Pugh. As the little party sets off on the long journey, they meet Van der Poel, a South African captain who begs a lift.

programme.title: The Prince, the Showgirl and Me
programme.desc: Documentary. Sir Laurence Olivier's personal assistant Colin Clark reveals the trials that beset The Prince and the Showgirl film with Marilyn Monroe.

programme.title: My Week with Marilyn
programme.desc: It is 1956, and The Prince and the Showgirl is being made at Pinewood Studios in London, directed by and starring Laurence Olivier, who has recruited one of the biggest Hollywood stars of all time, Marilyn Monroe, to co-star with him. Colin Clark, a junior assistant on the production, is assigned the job of looking after Marilyn and keeps a journal about the week he spent with her. It proves to be a turbulent experience as Marilyn is going through marital problems with her husband and uses Colin as a much-needed sounding board for all her pent-up neurosis. Acclaimed drama from BBC Films based on Clark's real-life diaries.

programme.title: Talking Pictures
programme.desc: Marilyn Monroe was, and perhaps will always be, Hollywood’s biggest female film icon and the sexiest of cinema's sex symbols, lighting up the screen in several cinema classics – including one of cinema’s greatest comedies, Some Like It Hot. The aura surrounding her has been enhanced by a sense of mystery that comes from the fact she was very rarely interviewed. But anyone who knew or worked with her was guaranteed to be asked about their personal 'Marilyn moments'. Here we tell Marilyn's story through the insights and anecdotes of friends, directors and fellow actors who spoke about her over the years on a selection of BBC programmes. With archive interviews featuring stars like Jane Russell, Jack Lemmon and Tony Curtis, as well as directors like Billy Wilder and John Huston, and Marilyn's former husband Arthur Miller, these conversations paint a picture of a star who conquered Hollywood despite serious battles with her inner demons, and reveal what it was like for those who got to enter into the orbit of one of cinema's greatest stars.

programme.title: Eve and Marilyn
programme.desc: 'She had a total understanding and control of the still camera... she was intelligent enough and sharp enough and beautiful enough to be able to manipulate almost any situation, so it became something which was totally her own...' Eve Arnold, one of the world's leading photo-journalists, remembers photographing Marilyn Monroe over the ten crucial years of Marilyn's stardom and decline. Going back to the original contact sheets and colour material, she tells of their friendship and what it was like as a woman to photograph Marilyn Monroe.

programme.title: Talking Pictures
programme.desc: Celia Imrie tells the story of the woman known as the Ice Queen of French cinema, the great Catherine Deneuve. Interview moments from the BBC's rich film archives provide Deneuve's own take on her fascinating and acclaimed career. We hear the stories of her experiences on classic movies like The Umbrellas of Cherbourg and The Hunger - and the controversial Belle de Jour. This latter film saw BBC cameras given unusually open behind-the-scenes access, capturing the tensions that made the film an unhappy experience, and yet also one that helped define Deneuve's image as cinema's ultimate 'cool blonde' over the decades that followed.

programme.title: The Interface
programme.desc: The show that reaches through your screen, to tell you the tech stories that ready matter. Hosted by BBC technology journalist Thomas Germain and social media expert Professor Jessica Maddox, The Interface dives into the stories, trends, apps, gadgets, algorithms and internet obsessions shaping how we live, work, think and connect. From AI and influencers to memes, data leaks, cybersecurity and the weirdest corners of the web, The Interface explores what happens when technology collides with real life. Cutting through the hype, the hosts unpack the platforms, products and online phenomena that increasingly shape our choices, our culture and our sense of self - whether we like it or not! Sharp, insightful and often very funny, The Interface examines our relationship with technology in all its messy, brilliant, absurd and world-changing glory. Along the way, it tackles one of the biggest questions of our age: what kind of future are the likes of Elon Musk, Chat GPT and all the other Silicon Valley giants building, and does anyone really want to live there?

programme.title: Wild Cameramen at Work
programme.desc: Five of the best wildlife cameramen in the world have their roots in Scotland: Doug Allan, Gordon Buchanan and Doug Anderson were all born north of the border, while John Aitchison and Mark Smith have chosen to make Scotland their home. In this stunning series they revisit some of their favourite natural history moments from their global careers, and tell us how Scotland has helped them hone their specialist skills for capturing some of the greatest images to grace our television screens. Narrated by David Attenborough - the first episode of this stunning new series reveals the hardships and hazards involved when filming wildlife in the world's most extreme environments - the Arctic and Antarctic. Legendary polar cameraman and diver Doug Allan relives some of his most hair-raising encounters and returns to the place where his underwater career began - the freezing depths of a Highland river.

programme.title: Beechgrove Garden
programme.desc: Jean Johansson is at Beechgrove, which has had a Christmas-style makeover. As part of a series helping families get ready for a fabulous Christmas, there are ideas to get your kids creating and crafting. Plus ways to make handmade presents, fabulous food and drink tips and gift suggestions, along with the usual top gardening advice from the Beechgrove team. In this episode, it’s all about the decorations. If you are about to choose a tree, just what should you be looking for? Once you’ve got one, there is expert advice on how to light and decorate it. And if you want a break from Christmas preparation, Carole Baxter will have advice on the garden jobs to be done right now.

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: A special episode from north Sutherland at the top of the Scottish mainland. Dougie steps out into the Flow Country, a vast expanse of blanket peat bog, where he charts the changes in its land use and its recent designation as a Unesco World Heritage site. Arlene catches up with sheep farmer Joyce Campbell to see how she has made the switch from traditional hill farming to regenerative agriculture. Arlene also visits Strath Halladale, where she meets a man who gave up city life to run the family croft 37 years ago. She finds out how he has built a thriving timber business and brought jobs to the area. And at Loch Hope, Leanna meets the biologists working to protect precious sea trout populations.

programme.title: Hamza's Hidden Wild Isles
programme.desc: Wonder is everywhere – if you know where to look. From sunny beaches to rugged moors, craggy munros to city streets, Hamza Yassin reveals amazing wildlife hidden around the UK. The limited edition booklet is no longer available to order, but you can download a version from the Open University’s website.

programme.title: Scot Squad
programme.desc: The Chief kicks-off his rugby-themed anti-crime campaign with the help of Scotland legend Gavin Hasting, while traffic cops Singh and McKirdy expertly utilise a dinosaur grabber in the name of socially distanced policing. Call responder Maggie Le Beau is well versed in the rudest place names on the map, and rural reorganisation has repercussions for the key partnership of McIntosh and Mackay.

programme.title: The Chief
programme.desc: Who better to record the audiobook of the autobiography of Scotland's greatest policeman than tartan Hollywood legend Dougray Scott? The work is entitled No Apologies, and the Chief is a stickler for detail. He is soon coaching Scott's performance on everything from historical case accuracy to sexiness. Will a tight deadline and the crime-fighting needs of a nation prevent the Chief achieving lyrical literary perfection? This is the story of the recording of the story of the making of the main man - Chief Commissioner Cameron Miekelson.

programme.desc: Documentary following Ethan Walker, a promising teenage footballer from Aberdeenshire who suffered life-threatening injuries in a road traffic accident just months into a football scholarship at a US university. Aided in his recovery by pioneering Scottish surgeon (and former footballer) Professor Gordon Mackay, Ethan undertakes a charity cycle ride from Glasgow to Munich for Scotland’s opening match against Germany in Euro 2024, just nine months after his accident. Entrusted by the Scottish national team to carry the match pennant on his back for the whole journey and deliver it in time for kick-off, Ethan is accompanied by Gordon, Tartan Army foot-soldier Stephen Collie and film-maker Martyn Robertson.

programme.title: Teen Predator/Online Killer
programme.desc: As police piece together the last few minutes of Cimarron’s life, they realise McCartney was still online threatening her when she tragically shot herself. Police and prosecutors move quickly to establish if there’s a case for manslaughter. Police from Northern Ireland travel to West Virginia to conduct the manslaughter investigation, where they learn that Cimarron’s own family had no idea why she took her own life. In a tragic turn, they learn that 18 months after her death, Cimarron’s father had also died by suicide. In order to charge McCartney with manslaughter, the police have to prove that he foresaw the risk to her life. As they comb through the cyber evidence from his devices, they build a case for manslaughter and charge him. The case sets new legal precedent in the UK. More than five years after the police investigation began, McCartney is finally convicted and sentenced.

programme.desc: Cardiff-based hopeless romantic Lewis just can’t help hearing wedding bells and talking through future life plans on date one, but that’s not the only obstacle to him getting a second date. If he’s not ranting about his exes, he’s zoning out mid-conversation, leaving his dates lost for words and never calling them again. Tired of listening to yet another of his first-date failures, Lewis’s best mate Megan thinks it’s time for an intervention, so she enlists the help one of Gen Z’s sassiest sex and relationships experts, Oloni, to drop some hard home truths on 20-year-old Lewis to try to end the bad habits that send his dates running for the hills. Oloni gives Lewis a reality check as his friends and exes tell it how it is via video feedback, explaining where it’s all going wrong. Oloni and Megan watch on as Lewis goes on a series of first dates that will challenge him to rethink his dating behaviour and become a better dater. programme.title: BBC Comedy Short Films
programme.desc: Sports mockumentary about GB Paralympian Darren Silverstone, who stole the hearts of a nation before his infamous chokey-o in Tokyo. For the first time, he tells his story - and starts his glorious comeback. In Tokyo 2020, Darren Silverstone was the Paras GB poster boy. (He was on yoghurts, too.) He cruised to the final and charmed the nation along the way with his signature dance move, the dazzle. But as he took that final bend ready to take gold, Silverstone lost his head and celebrated too soon - and in the process, became a national figure of fun. His subsequent journey in the public eye brought approval and consternation in equal measure: from those unforgettably self-deprecating betting adverts to his turn on The Masked Singer as Breadbin. Darren’s best friend and pilot rider in Tokyo, little Paul Potter, was never seen again in the public eye. The two haven’t spoken since. And now, Silverstone’s back. Ready to take to the tandem at Paris 2024. But is he ready? Who will he be riding with? This is I Am Darren.

He reads the Squirrels a story about Cookie the dog. It's a simple little story... that is, until the Squirrels join in with their ideas!

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: Winton has terrible toothache but isn’t ready to lose his fang. Zog and the doctors must help him feel proud again of the way he looks.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: The Piris plan a trip to Tippety Top to see the famous southern lights but lose each other in an ice fog. When Nugget thinks she sees a monster, Pancake proves to be an unlikely hero.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi wishes for rain so she can splash in puddles with her new boots, and even Aunty T discovers that rain can be lots of fun.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: The ducklings need help building a toy castle, but Weasy really wants to play on his new game console. He spots an invention from the Farm of the Future: an instant cloning machine. He decides to clone himself so that his double can help the ducklings instead.

programme.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
programme.desc: Zola steals art. Doc Ock finds Black Panther's tech.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: A west African savannah storm intrigues Paani until a mudslide forces Tunip into a ditch.

programme.title: Knee High Spies
programme.desc: The spies race to stop Silver Paw, Pranksy and Glitch from raiding Lauchie's piggy bank.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: A Mandarinteryx has moved into home base and is causing a big mess.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Supertato is delighted when Evil Pea comes to his birthday party, but Carrot is suspicious. Soon Evil Pea unleashes the Mini Peas, who try to steal Supertato’s birthday present.

programme.title: Gigglebiz
programme.desc: Arthur Sleep has missed the bus so Keith Fitt has a very important job to do: reading the news! It turns out reading the news is quite a difficult job. Loveable Humphrey enters a village show but his preparations nearly stop his neighbour showing off his prize marrow. The Berrito Brothers put on a display of strength in front of a depleted audience. QT has prepared a gruelling workout for Captain Adorable and Awesome Girl to make sure they're super-fit. Plus, another joke from the Gigglekids and more funny dancing in Silly Time.

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: A Very Important Pup visits Pup School for the grand opening of the school's brand new bug hotel. It's Dodge's special job to show the VIP around the school, but things don't go to plan. Dodge feels like he has let everyone down and thinks the VIP won't want to stay to open the new hotel... but things turn out very differently.

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Nyama is a type of stew from Zimbabwe. It uses a special type of young cabbage leaf called spring greens, which Pippa adds to her stew along with lots of other delicious ingredients. Pippa works hard preparing all the spices, chicken, tomatoes and shallots to make her tasty nyama for her friends. Pippa’s table is animal themed, complete with zebra prints and a toy giraffe! With her mum’s help, Pippa serves the nyama with sadza, a type of dumpling from Zimbabwe, and encourages her friends to eat with their fingers, as is traditional.

programme.title: I Can Grow It
programme.desc: Aaron and the Buds explore the wonderful world of climbing plants, discovering how ivy, sweet peas and raspberries grow tall and reach up for the sun in clever, twisty ways!

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: It’s a really hot day in the attic, and Murphi needs to cool the place down to stop Rebecca getting crabby. A paper plate crab is the first make of the day, with the usual supportive song from the Fabulous Fluffs. An old wooden spoon becomes a spoon monster, thanks to the creativity of the Mini Monsters, and Rebecca’s cousin builds a paper bag house. The Recycling Express provides yogurt pots for a palm tree, and the Tiny Helpers make the leaves.

programme.title: Balamory
programme.desc: When Ava’s dad can’t lead the Balamory Games, she searches for a new chieftain. But then Dynamite the Gladiator surprises her by placing the chieftain’s hat upon Ava’s head.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are playing in the clubhouse when Naughty Monkey arrives and causes chaos! He later returns to his home to relax, but there is a knock at his door. It's his cousins, who have come to visit. But it turns out they are even naughtier than Naughty Monkey!

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Join Captain Barnacles and his intrepid band of explorers for more deep sea adventures. The Octonauts wade through a swamp to find a lost flamingo chick before hungry predators do.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Sunny is writing a book about his favourite vet, but first he needs to ask her questions. Vida lets Sunny tag along on a day of house calls, so she can tell him everything he wants to know – in song!

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: When the Go Jetters find the Grimbots shipping overripe tomatoes into the Spanish town of Bunol, they put a stop to whatever Glitch is up to - until they find out that the tomatoes were destined for the famous Tomatina Festival, the biggest food fight in the world. Can the Go Jetters fix their own 'glitch' and save the festival?

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: When Cosima finally finds a quiet place to read her book, she realises peace and quiet aren't all they're made out to be. Where's Big Lizard when she needs him?

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Yukee’s garden friends help turn her ‘a day in my life’ homework assignment into an exciting, musical sound adventure.

programme.title: Froglets
programme.desc: After a garden barbecue, Ziff, Pipp and Button turn straws and snacks into agility games.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Educational series using Makaton sign language. Mr Tumble holds a swimming gala, while Justin and his friends enjoy summer at the seaside.

programme.title: What’s in Your Plant Pot?
programme.desc: Botanist Matilda and the Fact Pack explore the incredible Wollemi pine, a prehistoric plant from the time of the dinosaurs. They have fun making their own Wollemi pine fossils.

programme.title: Balamory
programme.desc: Penny coaches PC Plum for the You Laugh You Lose contest against the Harbour Master. But keeping a straight face and making the Harbour Master laugh is trickier than expected.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: Mara visits the clinic with an unusually curly fin, but the doctors don’t agree on the diagnosis. Can Zog reunite Pearl and Gadabout so that they work together on the cure?

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey, Snickers and Winton are ambushed by the Terriers on the way to see Calypso.

programme.title: MaeBee
programme.desc: It’s Mae and Bee’s first Acorn Exchange Day, but Mae’s attempts to teach Little Acorn the gnomish way tests Mae’s mighty patience to the limit!

programme.title: Tralala
programme.desc: Tralala finds the house too noisy until she joins the dust bunnies’ rock band.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi and Ruby are having the best play date ever, and they don't want Ruby to go home, so they make a wish to be stuck together. At first, it’s funny - they eat, play and do homework side by side. But soon their different ideas cause squabbles. With help from Jake and Dash, they remember why they wanted to stay together in the first place. Even best friends have differences, and that’s what makes them special.

programme.title: Nick Cope's Popcast
programme.desc: It's curry night, and Nick writes a song to help him remember to buy lots of healthy ingredients, but will he remember to buy Norman's dog treats?

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: It’s Make Something Epic Day, and Love Monster knows exactly what he is going to make. In a fantasy, he imagines standing at the top of an epic fort in the forest while his friends come to play with him. Out of the fantasy, Love Monster gets to work on a building using rocks, twigs and wood from the forest. But when he has finished building, the fort that he has made isn’t epic at all. It’s just a pile of rocks, twigs and wood. He realises that this might be a bigger job than he thought.

programme.title: Topsy and Tim
programme.desc: When Topsy and Tim's friends Tony Welch and Vinda come to play, things don't quite go to plan at first but by the time their mums come to pick them up, the friends are having so much fun they don't want to go home.

programme.title: Dylan's Playtime Adventures
programme.desc: Dylan the sculptor wants to sell his statues, but his statues have minds of their own!

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: Keith is excited to help the Piggies repair a fence, but it turns into a disaster. The little goat feels guilty. When they discover that Wilf is sabotaging everything, they can't let Keith give up!

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: When Yukee’s precious clockwork music box breaks, her garden friends cheer her up with a life-size clockwork performance of their own.

programme.title: Magic Hands
programme.desc: Look at what my hands can do! Aimee and Ashley are joined by a Dixie the Dog, dressed as crafty spider, and Bobbles the Bear, as the sweet and trusting fly, for the classic tale of The Spider and the Fly. Dixie uses all her charm and flattery to lure the young fly to her parlour. The poor little fly is unaware of the dangers that lie within!

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: An impatient Great Gnanna gets accidentally trapped with Gadabout in the dispensary. It’s a tense time for both of them, while Zog and Pearl race to set them free.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey, Snickers and Winton are ambushed by the Terriers on the way to see Calypso.

programme.title: Andy and the Band: Rock Star School
programme.desc: Andy and the Band take on their new roles as teachers at Rock Star School but soon realise this is no ordinary school. With the help of the talented Rock Star School kids, they soon find themselves on a mission solving mysteries in a world of magic, music and aliens!

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: At the wetland centre, JoJo and her friends Alfie, Raya, Jaxon and Isaiah find frog spawn. Gran Gran and Cynthia teach them about the life cycle of frog spawn to tadpole and frog. The friends want to see for themselves, so they each take it in turns to check in on the spawn. Once they’re fully grown, the frogs are found busy hopping all around. But JoJo manages to snap a quick photo of one and finish the life cycle project on the board.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Oona and Baba search for soft bedding for their burrow.

programme.title: Charlie and Lola
programme.desc: Children's animation. Siblings Lola and Charlie deal with topics that affect their everyday lives. Granny and Grandpa's house is by the sea where there are lots of fun things to do. However, Lola is worried that her imaginary friend might miss her while she is away. Charlie solves that problem. Then she says she is worried because Mum and Dad might miss her. Charlie comes up with another solution. Lola still does not want to go because she might miss Mum and Dad. Can Charlie help her?

programme.title: Moon and Me
programme.desc: In the Toy House, Colly Wobble has lost her shoes. In Storyland, Moon Baby shows Colly Wobble a magical shoe tree with different shoes growing on it. Colly Wobble chooses the flippers to try. What funny, flippy-flappy shoes, Colly Wobble!

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo and BaBa create a leaf picture, but the wind blows the leaves away. At Play Time, they decorate a pot - but it breaks when BaBa accidentally drops it. At Yummy Time, they decorate a special cookie and bring it with them across the Lullaby Lake. They have been trying to make a gift for Gramma Leeba, who reassures them that the best gift is made with love.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: Upsy Daisy gives her special stone to Igglepiggle to look after whilst she rides the Ninky Nonk. But Igglepiggle starts to play with the ball and forgets all about Upsy Daisy's stone! Makka Pakka finds the stone and gives it back to Igglepiggle so that he can give it back to Upsy just in time.

programme.desc: Join Perrie for a soothing story about the shapes that make up the world we love.
